DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Your place... is loud. But there's so much. While I wait, I'll take a look.
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Naturally! In this tedious waiting, just pick any forgotten gem and take it!
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: Still waiting? I'm in no rush—take your time picking through that pile. You can afford to wait, and so can I!
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: I have countless gems here, but I don't seem to have the one you're waiting for...
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char:
If you truly have the one I seek... it needn't shine. It only needs to arrive when it's meant to.
[i][font_size=22]Godot merely stands, like a nail blunted by time.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: ...Very well. Leave the choosing for next time. It seems you're accustomed to making "next time" a very long wait.
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You've fished me out of silence again... this time, where must I go to wait?
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: If you would grant me something... grant me the strength to wait one more time. Everything else, I do not lack.
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient:
[sine]...go... 
..I will... be where you... turn back... ..still there.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: A lavish room. A dazzling you. But I... am merely an old coat that hasn't been taken away yet.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: My, even an old coat can become radiant with my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancien: Are you waiting for a belated victory? Come here, let me dress you up more like a winner.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Even if you wish to tether yourself to a moment that will never arrive, you shouldn't look so disheveled.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I don't need to look fine. I only need it to be "not yet over."
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: You truly have no taste for beauty. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting—wearing my light, and wearing your patience.
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You're jumping. I'm waiting. Which of us is madder?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Neither is mad!! Neither is mad!! Try this to pass the time!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: Don't rush, don't rush! You mustn't rush! Waiting is... is... a very long bolt of lightning!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Giving you something!! What do you want? A sound that "will still ring tomorrow"!?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I've put silence in my pocket. Would you like to feel it?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep being loud, and you'll keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Your snoring is like the tide... I wait in the tide; I won't drown, only grow quieter.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me, and find peace in the tide...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]The waking always want to hurry on; only the sleeping understand staying... you should rest a while too...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh... a piece of flesh that "will never rush you"...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I don't fear pain. I only fear pain dragging me away from the waiting.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take it... so you can keep lying here... waiting for that road that hasn't come yet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: [b]No!! Take this weapon! Go grow stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: [b]Your blood has long gone cold! But battle can make even patience boil!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me—this is your fate right now!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char:
If I must fight... I'll wait until that person comes. He'll strike back for me.
[i][font_size=22]Godot steps back half a pace, as if yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: [b]Cowardice!! But you have endless patience!! Take this weapon and wait with it!!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth—it's "the appointed hour."
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: It's fine if the hour hasn't come. Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you a little while you wait.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancien: Is that bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter] the only baggage you carry? Shall I burn it away for you?
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Dear, try the [jitter][b]pastry[/b][/jitter] I made for you. The kind that must cool slowly, waited for slowly.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Empty and hungry feel much the same.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Very well, then take just one bite. And we'll keep waiting—waiting for the bitterness to [jitter][b]dissipate[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Demons make deals too. So what do you want from me? My time? It's worthless anyway.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Worthless [sine]time[/sine], once accumulated, becomes quite considerable...
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: I usually sell "now" at a premium. But facing you, I want to put a high price on [sine]"later"[/sine] as well.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: If I wrote a line in small print at the bottom of the contract: you are permitted to [sine]wait forever[/sine]—would you sign?
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...My name doesn't matter. What matters is that I haven't been called yet.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Take your price. I will never wake you—unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0r.an: You stand here, yet seem to be nowhere. What are you waiting for? The tower's peak? The ending? Or a word of permission?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1r.ch: ...I'm waiting for a name to be spoken. Until it is, I'm going nowhere.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-2r.an: Permission? You never needed it. You're just afraid of "having waited in vain."
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.an: You've returned again. Time is a corridor to you—you never finish walking it because you don't want to reach the end.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-1r.ch: A corridor is good. The end is not. The end means... no more waiting.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-2r.an: Foolish. If you never walk to the end, you will forever be merely an echo.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0r.an: Then stand. The tower will remember for you: you came, many times, and took nothing away.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1r.ch: Would taking something... make me stop waiting?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2r.an: It would. So don't take anything. Keep waiting—it's the only weapon you've ever mastered.
